issue.body:
## Problem

`history.json` grows without bound.

## Fix

After each write, `trimHistory` keeps the last 5 entries (the newest five, by position) and drops the rest.

## Done when

- [ ] At most 5 entries remain, and they are the newest five.
- [ ] A test with 7 entries checks that entries 3 through 7 remain.

pr.title: fix(sample-kit): cap history at five entries
pr.body: Adds trimHistory and calls it after each write, with a test.
